author: Moll & Roch, 1931

note.en: A shipworm that bores through submerged wood, known here from three 1936 museum specimens labelled Limón. Size is the approximate length of the worm-like body.
note.es: Un teredo que perfora madera sumergida, conocido aquí por tres ejemplares de museo de 1936 rotulados Limón. El tamaño es la longitud aproximada del cuerpo vermiforme.

evidence: GBIF: 3 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections)
recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: A shipworm that bores through submerged wood, known here from three 1936 museum specimens labelled Limón.
